description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for the registration screen in a healthcare application. It includes form fields for email, password, and user role, handles validation, and manages user registration via an AuthProvider. The widget navigates to different screens based on registration success.

classes.name: RegisterScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that presents a registration form for new users, manages form validation, registration logic, and navigation post-registration.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the RegisterScreen widget.

methods.name: _RegisterScreenState
methods.description: State class managing the registration form's state, input controllers, validation, submission, and navigation.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text editing controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _validateEmail
methods.description: Validates the email input to ensure it is non-empty and resembles an email pattern.

methods.name: _validatePassword
methods.description: Validates the password input for minimum length and non-empty.

methods.name: _validateRole
methods.description: Checks that a role has been selected.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form validation, triggers registration via AuthProvider, manages navigation on success, and shows error messages.

methods.name: _goToLogin
methods.description: Navigates the user to the login screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the registration form UI, including input fields, validation, and buttons.
